names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 15 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Ελπίδιος, Μάρκελλος και Ευστόχιος», with the rank words left off. The line enumerates the three; the bare personal name is taken out of it.

Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 15 ноября ст. ст., «Маркелл, мч.», with the rank word left off. The calendar gives the three no toponymic and no surname, so the stored form is the bare forename the link carries; the line itself has it in the genitive.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 15. новембар ст. ст., „Св. муч. Елпидије, Маркел и Евстохије.“ — «Св.» is “saint”, «муч.» is the `martyr` grade, and the names beside his are the company; the heading prints nothing else, so the form is the bare forename as the book spells it, with one «л», and it is not bent towards the Russian «Маркелл» this folder also holds.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 15ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Ελπίδιος, Μάρκελλος και Ευστόχιος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 15 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The line enumerates its three members, so it is a folder for each and each relates the other two, on `docs/CORPUS.md` §10.1. The page: Elpidius was a member of the Senate and lived when the emperor was Julian the Apostate, who took him and told him to choose between denying Christ and a martyr's death, and he chose the second without turning aside; two colleagues and friends of his, Marcellus and Eustochius, went to martyrdom with him; boiling water was thrown on their flesh, the limbs of their bodies were broken with heavy iron rods, and in that state they were thrown into the fire. **No `dates` proposed**: the only year on the page hangs on a reign — «όταν αυτοκράτορας ήταν ο Ιουλιανός ο παραβάτης (361 μ.Χ.)» — which is the formula this corpus refuses, on the `carterius-of-caesarea` precedent; the reign is in the life instead. No `locations` and no hymn: the page gives neither. The corpus holds other folders of all three names, none of them kept on 15 November in any calendar, so the slugs carry the day. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 28.11.2025 (15. новембар ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Елпидије, Маркел и Евстохије.“

attestations.note: The second name in the day's second entry. The book says nothing of him apart from his name in that company and the reign; `dates` UNTOUCHED, no `types` and no `office`. The form joins no fold: measured, no other folder in the corpus holds the bare «Маркел». The nearest strings are a different key each — the bare «Маркелл» with two л, which this folder itself holds in `ru` beside `marcellus-the-martyr-1-march`; «Маркел Апамејски» on `marcellus-of-apamea`, two words; «Маркелин» on `marcellinus-of-rome`; and «Маркела» on `marcella-of-chios`.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru closes the line of the three for 15 ноября ст. ст. with «(IV)», the fourth century. Its life sets them «при императоре Юлиане Отступнике (361 - 363)», and saint.gr gave 361 for the same reign; those are the reign’s years and not theirs, and no narrower interval is taken from them. The century is the calendar’s own statement about the three.
